project.name: vog-desk
project.summary: A volcanic-smog forecast desk for Pahala, Hawaii Island: at 18:00 HST a calibrated probability that any hour at the Pahala monitor reaches 75 ppb SO2 by noon, a recommendation under the 2018 schools SO2 action plan, a discussion in which every number cites its evidence, and next-day verification written into memory.

builders.name: Zeyu Sun
builders.role: owner: decisions, data, model, agents, evaluation, writing

zetaris.use_case_note: Every evidence item an agent cites is a run_sql query over the pahala_exposure Unified Semantic Layer, rewritten with available_utc <= issue time; the Python fallback exists for judges without Zetaris and a test checks the two agree.
zetaris.how: Eight sources (EPA AQS, AirNow, USGS HVO episodes with notice publication times, Hilo soundings, NOAA GFS points as Parquet on a local S3 store; stations, action-plan levels, forecasts and verifications in Postgres over JDBC) behind one USL with eight governed tables, each carrying available_utc, and eleven data quality rules. The desk's own forecasts and verifications are written to Postgres and read back through Zetaris.
data_sources: USGS HVO episodes and HANS notices

meterless.use_case_note: H-MEM holds every verified night with source and confidence; the ForecasterAgent retrieves ten analog nights as of the issue time with the engine's ranking and a trace; the Verifier writes the night back and gives helpful/wrong feedback through the trust ledger; night-level conflicts resolve through the engine's 0.70 gate. The World Model holds each case's events.
meterless.how: The Meterless reference implementations run unchanged in a Node sidecar (conformance H-MEM 13 of 13, World Model 8 of 8). The sidecar adds the information cutoff: records carry available_utc and a query as of T sees only nights verified by T. All model calls go through Meterless Nightshift with explicit Nemotron ids.

nvidia.use_case_note: Lightning writes the evidence summary (thinking off, validated against the evidence); Ultra is the DutyLead that weighs the guidance streams and writes the cited discussion. provider_model is logged on every call.
nvidia.how: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b and nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b through NVIDIA's free endpoint registered in Nightshift; the trace names the model that answered each step.

cursor.use_case_note: Cursor built the Nightshift provider block in src/vogdesk/llm.py from the meterless.ai POWER recipe (git tag cursor-provider); the main build used Claude Code and Codex. All code was read and tested by the author.
cursor.how: Cursor free tier, one bounded piece; reviewed before merge.

pre_existing.name: Meterless reference engines
pre_existing.what: H-MEM and World Model reference implementations, conformance suites and specs from github.com/meterless/Meterless, Apache-2.0, vendored unchanged.

pre_existing.name: Windward
pre_existing.what: The author's Hawaii terrain and sea-breeze scene, reused for the demo replay only; no forecast code comes from it.
